overview: An integrated disaster early warning and emergency resource platform that provides real-time disaster alerts, location-based emergency assistance, and safety guidance for citizens in disaster-prone areas.
features: Real-time disaster alerts dashboard with color-coded severity (flood, storm, cyclone, earthquake)
Location-based emergency assistance with nearest shelters, hospitals, and relief centers
Emergency resources finder with filtering by type
SOS emergency contact button with helpline numbers
Safety tips and preparedness checklists for each disaster type
7-page responsive web app: Home, Alerts, Safe Places, Resources, Safety Tips, About, Contact
